texts.Add one additional Force Organisation Sl: Add one additional Force Organisation Slot to the Detachment that includes the Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage. The Slot added may be of any Battlefield Role other than High Command, Command, Warlord or Lord of War (note that a Detachment may gain more than one additional Force Organisation Slot if this option is selected for multiple Units in the same Detachment). Each Unit selected to fill such a Slot must: Be from the Legiones Astartes Army List. Not include any Models that have the Unique Sub-Type. Have a Faction Trait that matches the Legion that is represented by the Model that was selected to fill the Battlefield Role Slot with this Prime Advantage.

One Model in the Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage gains the following benefits: Has its Base Weapon Skill Characteristic modified by +1. texts.Optae Space Wolves dans une Case Princip: If an Optae that has the Space Wolves Trait is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Pack Thegn A Model selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage: Has its Base Attacks and Weapon Skill Characteristics modified by +1. texts.Centurion Imperial Fists dans une Case P: A Model selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage: Gains an auguryscanner Cannot select any of the Centurion’s listed options and instead must have their bolter exchanged for one of the following options for Free: Heavybolter Autocannon Iliastus assault cannon
texts.Unité composée uniquement de Figurines B: Models in a Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage gain the Fear(1) Special Rule.
texts.Unité Iron Hands de Rôle Tactique État-m: If a Unit which only includes Models with the Iron Hands Trait and the Command Battlefield Role is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: The Iron-clad This Prime Advantage can only be selected once per Army. Add one additional War Engines Battlefield Role Slot to the Detachment that includes the Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage. A Unit that is selected to fill that Slot gains the Champion Sub-Type if it did not already have it.
texts.Unité Ultramarines de Rôle Tactique État: Add one additional Transport or Heavy Transport Battlefield Role Slot to the Detachment that includes the Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage. Modify the Transport Capacity of a Unit that is selected to fill that Slot by +2.
texts.Unité Salamanders de Rôle Tactique Troup: If a Unit which only includes Models with the Salamanders Trait that has the Troops Battlefield Role is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Duty Before Death Models in a Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage gain the Feel No Pain(6+) Special Rule.
texts.Unité Raven Guard de Rôle Tactique Troup: Models in a Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage gain the Wraiths Special Rule. Wraiths: After the Controlling Player makes a Rush Move with a Unit that includes only Models with this Special Rule, they may also choose to make a Willpower Check for that Unit. If the Willpower Check is successful, any Charges targeting the selected Unit in the Assault Phase of the following Player Turn are Disordered. If the Willpower Check is failed, the selected Unit instead gains the Stunned Tactical Status.
texts.Centurion Tartaros Emperor's Children su: If a Tartaros Centurion Model that has the Emperor’s Children Trait is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Phoenix Warden A Model selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage: Must have its combi-bolter and powerweapon exchanged for a Phoenix power spear for Free. Gains the Skill Unmatched Special Rule.
texts.Unité composée uniquement de Figurines d: If a Unit that has the Iron Warriors Trait that includes only Models with the Infantry Type is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: The Unfavoured All Models in the Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage gain the Expendable(1) Special Rule.
texts.Centurion en Armure Terminator, Escouade: Models in a Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage gain the Deep Strike and Impact (I) Special Rules.
texts.Unité de Rôle État-major entièrement Wor: This Prime Advantage can only be selected once per Army. When this Prime Advantage is selected, the Controlling Player must select another Unit which only includes Models with the World Eaters Trait that has the Command Battlefield Role from their Army. One Model in the selected Unit and one Model in the Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage both gain the Chain-brothers Special Rule. Chain-brothers: While a Model with this Special Rule is within Unit Coherency of the other Model from your Army with this Special Rule, that Model gains a bonus of +1 to Hit Tests made in the Assault Phase. If a Model that is engaged in a Challenge is in the same Combat as the other Model from your Army with this Special Rule, that Model is treated as being in Unit Coherency with that other Model for the purposes of this Special Rule.
texts.Centurion ou Centurion Cataphractii Deat: If a Centurion Model with the Death Guard Trait or a Cataphractii Centurion Model with the Death Guard Trait is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Unnatural Resilience This Prime Advantage can only be selected once per Army. A Model selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage: Has its Base Wounds Characteristic modified by +1. Gains the Eternal Warrior(2) Special Rule. texts.Unité de Rôle Troupes entièrement Thousa: If a Unit which only includes Models with the Thousand Sons Trait and the Troops Battlefield Role is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Telekine Shift Models in a Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage gain the Telekine Shift Special Rule. Telekine Shift: When the Controlling Player chooses to make a Rush Move with a Unit made up of Models with this Special Rule, they may also choose to make a Willpower Check for that Unit. If the Willpower Check is successful, the Unit gains the Antigrav Sub-Type and the Move Through Cover Special Rule until the end of the current Movement Phase. If the Willpower Check is failed, the selected Unit may not Move during the current Movement Phase.
texts.Unité de Rôle Élite entièrement Sons of: If a Unit which only includes Models with the Sons of Horus Trait and the Elites Battlefield Role is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Martial Supremacy One Model in the Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage gains the Champion Sub-Type and the Duellist’s Edge(1) Special Rule.
texts.Unité de Rôle Troupes entièrement Word B: If a Unit which only includes Models with the Word Bearers Trait and the Troops Battlefield Role is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Zealous Assault Models in a Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage gain the Impact (S) Special Rule.
texts.Unité de Rôle État-major entièrement Alp: If a Unit which only includes Models with the Alpha Legion Trait that has the Command Battlefield Role is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Rewards of Treachery Add one additional Battlefield Role Slot to the Detachment that includes the Unit selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot with this Prime Advantage. This Slot may be of any Battlefield Role other than High Command, Command, Warlord or Lord of War (note that a Detachment may gain more than one additional Force Organisation Slot if this option is selected for multiple Units in the same Detachment). Each Unit selected to fill such a Slot must: Be from the Legiones Astartes Army List. Not have the Alpha Legion Faction Trait on their Unit Profile. Not include any Models that have the Unique Sub-Type.
texts.Unité composée uniquement d'Automates Cy: This Prime Advantage may only be selected for a Unit composed entirely of Models with both the Automata Type and the Cybernetica Trait. One Model in a Unit for which this Prime Advantage is selected, chosen by the Controlling Player, has its Base Leadership, Intelligence and Willpower modified by +4 each, its base Initiative and Weapon Skill modified by +1 each, and gains the Sergeant Sub-Type. The Model that gains these benefits is also counted as a Tech-priest with the Cybernetica Trait for the purposes of The Deus Machina Arcana Benefice only.
texts.Unité composée uniquement de Figurines d: This Prime Advantage may only be selected for a Unit composed entirely of Models with both the Infantry Type and the Lacrymaerta Trait. All Models in a Unit for which this Prime Advantage is selected have the Base Value of their Strength Characteristic modified by +2 and the Base Value of their Wounds Characteristic modified by +1.
texts.Unité d'une seule Figurine de Type Véhic: This Prime Advantage may only be selected for a Unit composed of a single Model with the Vehicle Type that does not also have the Super-heavy Sub-Type. A Model for which this Prime Advantage is selected gains a bonus of +1 to its Front and Side Armour Values, to a maximum of 14, +2 to its Hull Points Characteristic. If the Unit selected includes any Models with the Transport Sub-Type, then the Transport Capacity of those Models is also modified by +2.
texts.Cohorte de Thallax seulement : Sauvegard: This Prime Advantage may only be selected for a Thallax Cohort Unit. All Models in a Unit with this Prime Advantage increase the Base Value of their Invulnerable Save Characteristic to 5+ and increase the Base Value of their Leadership Characteristic by +1.
texts.This Prime Advantage may only be selecte: This Prime Advantage may only be selected for a Prime Slot used to select a Shield Captain Unit. All Models in the Unit selected to fill a Prime Slot with this Prime Advantage modify their Base Wounds Characteristic by +1 and gain the Officer of the Line(2) Special Rule.
texts.All Models in the Unit selected to fill: All Models in the Unit selected to fill a Prime Slot with this Prime Advantage which have the Legio Custodes Trait and the Infantry or Cavalry Type modify the value of X of any version of the Eternal Warrior (X) Special Rule they have to ’2’. This Prime Advantage may only be selected once per Army, unless the Army contains any Models with the Golden Exemplar Trait, in which case a single additional selection of this Prime Advantage may be made for each Model in the Army with that Trait.
texts.Add three additional slots of the Suppor: Add three additional slots of the Support Battlefield Role to the Detachment that includes the Prime Slot with this Prime Advantage. These Force Organisation Slots may only be filled by Units selected from the Divisio Assassinorum Army List. This Prime Advantage may only be selected for a single Force Organisation Slot in an Army’s Primary Detachment.
texts.Si ce Chevalier détruit la dernière figu: If an attack made by a Model with this Questoris Vow causes the last Model in an enemy Unit selected to fill a High Command Force Organisation Slot to be Removed as a Casualty, the amount of Victory Points that would be scored by the Controlling Player as a result for achieving any version of the Slay the Warlord (X) Secondary Objective is increased by 2.
texts.S'il détruit la dernière figurine d'une: If an attack made by a Model with this Questoris Vow causes the last Model in an enemy Unit selected to fill a Lord of War or Warlord Force Organisation Slot to be Removed as a Casualty, then the amount of Victory Points that would be scored by the Controlling Player as a result for achieving any version of the Giant Killer (X) Secondary Objective is increased by 2.
texts.S'il est encore sur le champ de bataille: If a Model with this Questoris Vow remains on the Battlefield at the end of the Battle, then the amount of Victory Points that would be scored by the Controlling Player for achieving any version of the Last Man Standing (X) Secondary Objective is increased by 2.
texts.S'il détruit une unité ennemie ou la fai: If, during the Controlling Player’s first Player Turn, an attack made by a Model with this Questoris Vow causes the last Model in an enemy Unit to be Removed as a Casualty, or causes an enemy Unit to Fall Back off the Battlefield, then the amount of Victory Points that would be scored by the Controlling Player for achieving any version of the First Strike (X) Secondary Objective is increased by 2.
texts.La première fois que ce Chevalier marque: The first time in a Battle each Model with this Questoris Vow scores Victory Points due to the Vanguard (X) Special Rule, the number of Victory Points gained by the Controlling Player is increased by 2.
texts.La première fois qu'une unité amie à 12\: The first time in a Battle a friendly Unit with at least one Model within 12" of a Model with this Questoris Vow scores an Objective, the value of that Objective is modified by +2 for the duration of the Victory Sub-Phase of that End Phase.
texts.Récompense le Chevalier engagé dans le p: If a Model with this Questoris Vow is part of the first Combat in a Battle for which the Controlling Player is declared the winner, the Controlling Player gains 2 Victory Points.
texts.Coordinated Manoeuvres : la première Réa: Coordinated Manoeuvres: In each of the Active Player’s Movement, Shooting and Assault Phases, a single Lasrifle Section can perform a Reaction for one less point of Reaction Allotment.
texts.Shock Assault : les unités Vanguard (X): Shock Assault: Models with this Special Rule and the Vanguard (X) Special Rule that Disembark from a Dracosan do not make Disordered Charges.
texts.Strike and Fade : la Cavalerie peut teni: Strike and Fade: Models with this Special Rule and the Cavalry Type can Control Objectives and move further as part of the Evade Reaction.
texts.Rolling Advance : un Véhicule (hors Flye: Rolling Advance: Models with this Special Rule may Move and still benefit from the Heavy (X) Special Rule.
texts.Ceaseless Bombardment : +1 à la valeur d: Ceaseless Bombardment: Models with this Special Rule improve the value of the Pinning (X) Special Rule on any Barrage Weapons they have by +1.
texts.Iron over Flesh : toutes les Lasrifle Se: Iron over Flesh: Every Model in a Lasrifle Section Unit in an Army with the Iron Pattern Cohort Doctrine gains the Expendable(1) Special Rule.

rtexts.Sire des Night Lords: If a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the Controlling Player may apply the following additional Special Rules to all Auxiliary, Apex and Primary Detachments that have the same Faction Trait as the Model with this Special Rule:
rtexts.Une Mort Annoncée de Longue Date: If the Controlling Player succeeds at a Dice Roll, they may select this Gambit instead of any others normally available.
rtexts.Songes Ténébreux: The Controlling Player may attempt to gain a Damage Mitigation Roll for Sevatar.
rtexts.Close Order: Models with this Special Rule increase the value of the Line (X) Special Rule for nearby Friendly Models with the Infantry Tercio Trait.
rtexts.Independent Fire: Models with this Special Rule can shoot at multiple targets at full Ballistic Skill.
rtexts.Tir Indépendant: Models with this Special Rule can shoot at multiple targets at full Ballistic Skill.
rtexts.Rapier Section: Models with this Special Rule resolve Shooting Attacks and Attacks made in Combat against different Toughness Characteristics from their Unit.
rtexts.Hold the Line: Models with this Special Rule provide a Feel No Pain Damage Mitigation Roll to nearby Models with the Veletaris Tercio Trait against Volley and Reaction Attacks.
rtexts.Structure Renforcée: A Model with this Special Rule suffers less Damage from most Weapons.
rtexts.Champion de la Mort: Sigismund’s attacks are more deadly when this Gambit is selected.
rtexts.L'Impôt du Bourreau: Fafnir Rann may suffer a negative modifier to the Focus Roll in exchange for improved attacks.
rtexts.Le Feu Inextinguible: Vulkan may regenerate lost Wounds when this Gambit is selected.
rtexts.Preneur de Têtes: This Gambit prevents the Opposing Player from gaining a bonus to the Focus Roll from Outside Support.
rtexts.Hurlement du Loup Funeste: When this Gambit is selected, Leman Russ gains a fixed bonus to the Focus Roll in Challenges until he fails to wound his opponent.
rtexts.Bretteur Réfléchi: Guilliman gains a bonus to the Focus Roll based on the Battle Turn number.
rtexts.Rempart de l'Imperium: This Gambit allows Rogal Dorn to fight defensively.
rtexts.Le Seigneur Ombreux: This Gambit allows Corax to fight as if he had not suffered any Wounds.
rtexts.Trempé par la Guerre: Whilst this Gambit is selected, Ferrus Manus has an increased Toughness Characteristic.
rtexts.La Ligne Intacte: Camba Diaz gains additional attacks when he fights last in a Challenge.
rtexts.Coup de Marteau: Alexis Polux can make an alternative attack during a Challenge.
rtexts.Commandant Spatial: If a Model with this Special Rule joins a Breacher Squad Unit in Reserves, Models in that Unit gain the Deep Strike Special Rule while this Model is part of the Unit. In addition, when a Model with this Special Rule is deployed as part of a Deep Strike, that Model and each other Model in the same Unit gain the Feel No Pain(5+) Special Rule until the Controlling Player’s next Effects Sub-Phase.
rtexts.Archein de Sagesse: This Gambit allows Raldoron to benefit from his Opponent’s successful Hit Rolls in a later Strike Step.
rtexts.Combattant Déloyal: This Gambit allows Sevatar to make an attack outside of the normal sequence.
rtexts.Sang de Sorcier: Calas Typhon has the Biomancy Discipline if included in an Army that does not include Mortarion.
rtexts.Bataille des Volontés: This Gambit allows the Controlling Player to use Magnus’ Willpower Characteristic to gain a positive modifier to the Focus Roll.
rtexts.Un Frère Trahi: This Gambit allows Saul Tarvitz to gain benefits when fighting specific opponents.
rtexts.La Lame Exemplaire: Lucius gains an increased benefit from the Paragon of Excellence Gambit.
rtexts.Chercheur d'Expiation: This Gambit allows Hibou Khan to avoid being Removed as a Casualty.
rtexts.Seigneur des Sables Écarlates: Angron may fight successive Challenges in a Turn.
rtexts.Parangons de l'Ordre: When a Unit that includes any Models with this Special Rule is selected as part of a Detachment, during Army selection, a single option from the Orders of the Hekatonystika presented below must be selected for all Models in that Unit.
rtexts.Héritage de Ruse: A Model with this Special Rule can be removed from play without the Opposing Player scoring Victory Points.
rtexts.Assaut au Liquifractor: This Gambit allows Draykavac to attack first with the Liquifractor.
rtexts.Véhicule d'État-major Mobile: A Model with this Special Rule can use some Characteristics of Embarked Models instead of its own.
rtexts.Médic: This Reaction allows the Reactive Player to make Recovery Tests for a Unit that is the target of a Shooting Attack if the Target Unit has a Medic.
rtexts.Baie de Transport Stormbird: A Sokar Stormbird can transport larger Models, including one Rhino, as well as Infantry.
rtexts.Baie de Transport Mastodon: A Mastodon Super-heavy Assault Transport can transport larger Models as well as Infantry.
rtexts.Le Courroux du Lion: The Lion gains a bonus to Focus Rolls when he is wounded.
rtexts.Compagnons: While a Model with both the Dark Angels Trait and either the Paragon Type or Command Sub-Type is part of a Unit that includes any Models with this Special Rule, Precision Wounds caused as part of a Shooting Attack cannot be allocated to that Model.
rtexts.Mort par Mille Coupures: This Gambit reduces the strength of an opponent when they are wounded.
rtexts.Élu du Khagan: This Special Rule ensures the arrival of a Unit held in Reserves.
rtexts.Fléau des Seigneurs: Varagyr gain a bonus to their Combat Resolution if the Thegn survives a Challenge.
rtexts.Les Songes du Loup Funeste: Deathsworn make a final attack before they are Removed as a Casualty.
rtexts.Formation en Phalange: Phalanx Warders may make the Shieldwall! Reaction without expending a Reaction Allotment point, but suffer limitations for doing so.
rtexts.Descente Angélique: Sanguinius can use a Gambit to gain a bonus when fighting larger enemies.
rtexts.Embrasez le Ciel: A Unit with this Special Rule cannot be intercepted by distant enemy Units when they arrive on the Battlefield.
rtexts.Propulseur Incaendius: When a Model with this Special Rule makes a Rush, it gains the Antigrav Sub-Type for the duration of that Movement Phase.
rtexts.Seigneur des Automates: This Special Rule allows an Iron Father to be accompanied by a Unit of Battle-automata.
rtexts.Frappe Fatale: Fatal Strike temporarily increases the Ballistic Skill Characteristic.
rtexts.Rejeton de la Corruption: Fulgrim Transfigured cannot be included in the same Army as Fulgrim.
rtexts.Seigneur de la Corruption: Angron Transfigured cannot be included in the same Army as Angron.
rtexts.Fauchage: If a Model with this Special Rule is outnumbered, it gains extra attacks.

rtexts.Conduit Psychique: Castellax-Achea can have wounds suffered as a result of Perils of the Warp applied to them instead.
rtexts.Le Maître de Guerre Exalté: Horus Ascended cannot be included in the same Army as Horus Lupercal.
rtexts.Survivant-né: This Special Rule allows Garviel Loken to avoid being Removed as a Casualty.
rtexts.Émissaire du Chaos: An Army whose Primary Detachment includes a Model with this Special Rule may select Daemonic Manifestation Auxiliary Detachments regardless of how many Command Force Organisation Slots are filled with Esoterist Units.
rtexts.Entraveur d'Âmes: Zardu Layak has specific Psychic Powers.
rtexts.Le Briseur: This Gambit allows a friendly Unit to make a Shooting Attack targeting a Model that Perturabo is in a Challenge with.
rtexts.Comptrôleur (X): If a Model with this Special Rule is part of a Unit then it can score more Victory Points for holding an Objective.
rtexts.Même les Immortels Peuvent Avoir Peur: All Models in a Unit that includes any Models with any version of the [Mechanicum] Trait modify their Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill Characteristics by -1 while at least one Model from that Unit is within 12" of one or more enemy Models with this Arcana Benefice. This Arcana Benefice has no effect on Units which only include Models with the Malagra Trait.

rtexts.Precision Bombardment: Models with this Special Rule decrease the Scatter distance of Shooting Attacks made by nearby Models with the Artillery Tercio Trait.
rtexts.Armoured Warfare: Models with this Special Rule provide the Auto-repair (4+) Special Rule to nearby Units with the Armour Tercio Trait.

rtexts.Bitter Duty: Models with this Special Rule may not join Units that do not also have this Special Rule.

rtexts.Consul-Delegatus: A Command Model with this Special Rule unlocks an Apex Detachment, but awards Victory Points for Slay the Warlord.
rtexts.Auxiliary Transport Bays: A Thunderhawk Transporter can transport some Vehicle Models as well as Infantry.
rtexts.Order of the Broken Claws: This Special Rule provides bonuses when Models with it are Locked in Combat with larger enemies.
rtexts.Vengeful Hate: Rylanor can fight in a Challenge when Fulgrim is the Challenger.
rtexts.Designated Quarry: Models with this Special Rule can have their Ballistic Skill improved once per Battle against a specific target.
rtexts.Macro-auspex: When not attacking Titans, Knights or Super-heavies, a Weapon with this Special Rule must make Snap Shots.
rtexts.The Blade of Wisdom: Models with this Special Rule gain a bonus when Locked in Combat with Units which have Tactical Statuses.
rtexts.Creed of Flame: Models with this Special Rule can make Volley Attacks with Weapons with the Flame Trait.
rtexts.Corax's Shame: Models with this Special Rule suffer restrictions when in an Army with Corvus Corax.
rtexts.Surgical Suite: A Model with this Special Rule allows Recovery Tests to be made in the Morale Sub-Phase, but is automatically Removed as a Casualty if it is ever the only Model in a Unit.
rtexts.Triage: Models with this Special Rule can give a version of Expendable (X) to Solar Auxilia Units.
rtexts.Navigator's Arts: A Model with this Special Rule has a specific Psychic Discipline.
rtexts.Ritual Healing: A Model with this Special Rule has the Resurrection Psychic Reaction.
rtexts.Medicae Support: Medicae Auxiliaries are deployed and operate individually.
rtexts.Demolition Vehicle: Vehicles with this Special Rule can make Charges and inflict automatic Hits on every Model in a Combat if they are successful.
rtexts.Independent Sentries: Tarantulas are deployed and operate individually.
rtexts.Automated Fire Protocols: A Model with this Special Rule may not make Shooting Attacks except as part of a Reaction.
rtexts.Anbaric Claw: A Vehicle with this Special Rule inflicts more Damage when it moves through enemy Units.
rtexts.Weapons Array: Weapons with this Special Rule may make Shooting Attacks into multiple Firing Arcs.
rtexts.Platform: Models can be placed on top of this Model as if it were an Area of Terrain.
rtexts.Armoured Platform: Models can be placed on top of this Model as if it were an Area of Terrain.
rtexts.Aegis Barricades: Any Model with the Infantry or Paragon Types that is in base contact with an Aegis Barricade gains a 5+ Cover Save.
rtexts.Firing Point (X): A Model with this Special Rule can make extra attacks equal to the value of X with the Weapons of Embarked Models.
rtexts.Orbital Defense: Enemy Drop Pods that deploy within 18" of a Model with this Special Rule suffer automatic Hits.
rtexts.Proof of Valour: Hit Tests resolved for Models with a Weapon Skill of 5 against a Unit entirely composed of Models with this Special Rule are only successful on a 4+.
rtexts.Certainty and Resolve: Models with this Special Rule are never removed as Casualties when they Fall Back into a Battlefield Edge, and are more likely to have the Routed Tactical Status removed from them in the End Phase.
rtexts.Barbaran Resilience: A Unit containing any Models with this Special Rule never gains the Routed Tactical Status due to suffering 25% or more Casualties in the Shooting Phase.
rtexts.Unattuned Practitioners: Thousand Sons Inductii Models have a specific Prosperine Arcana.
rtexts.Creed of Brutality: If a Unit containing any Models with this Special Rule succeeds on a Leadership Check in the Start Phase, they gain the Impact (S) Special Rule until the end of the Battle Turn.
rtexts.Empty Vessels: A Unit containing any Models with this Special Rule gains the Malefic Sub-Type and the Feel No Pain(6+) Special Rule once it scores Victory Points due to the Vanguard (X) Special Rule, after suffering D3 wounds.
rtexts.Wargear of Heroes: Models with this Special Rule which inflict any unsaved wounds confer a bonus to Combat Resolution scores.
rtexts.Unchained Conviction: Models with this Special Rule which would gain the Pinned Tactical Status instead make an immediate Fall Back Move.
rtexts.Treacherous Lure: A Unit entirely composed of Models with this Special Rule cannot be targeted by Shooting Attacks during the first Battle Turn.
rtexts.Fangs of the Emperor: All Units in the same Primary Detachment as Endryd Haar gain the Infiltrate(12) Special Rule.
rtexts.The Riven Hound: This Gambit allows Endryd Haar to make a single attack with a higher Strength and that causes more Damage.
rtexts.Among the Ranks: Models with this Special Rule are deployed and operate individually.
rtexts.Instil Order: Models with this Special Rule can inflict wounds on their Unit in order to remove a Tactical Status in the Start Phase.
rtexts.Rapier Crew: The Characteristics of different Models with this Special Rule are used in different situations.
rtexts.Emplaced: Models with this Special Rule are Removed as Casualties instead of making Fall Back Moves.
rtexts.Heavy Ordnance Crew: The Characteristics of different Models with this Special Rule are used in different situations and they are Removed as Casualties instead of making Fall Back Moves.
rtexts.Fusion (X): This Special Rule increases the amount of Damage against Vehicles when Shooting Attacks are made within a specific range.
rtexts.Suiveurs Zélés: Bonepickers may use the Characteristics of nearby Skitarii Units when making Characteristic Checks.
rtexts.Inductii: A Unit containing any Models with this Special Rule may never be used to select a Prime Advantage.
rtexts.Irregulars: A Unit composed of Models with this Special Rule can still score Objectives when Pinned, Stunned or Suppressed, and is automatically destroyed when it Falls Back into contact with a Battlefield Edge.
rtexts.Third-Line: Models with this Special Rule lose a Hull Point when they suffer a Glancing Hit.
rtexts.Mutable Tactics: Models with the Shattered Legions Trait have variable bonuses from this Special Rule based on which Legions have been selected for the Army.
rtexts.Bastard Sons of Fate: Blackshields gain bonuses to Toughness and Strength when under the effect of certain Battlefield Statuses.
rtexts.Loot the Dead (X): This Special Rule grants a new option for Units that win a Combat, allowing them to score Victory Points but forcing them to become Pinned.
rtexts.Doomed Heroics (X): Whenever at least one Unit that includes a majority of Models with this Special Rule is on the winning side of a Combat where one or more of the following was true at the start of the Fight Sub-Phase, then the Controlling Player scores a number of Victory Points equal to the value of X (where there are multiple variants of this Special Rule in a Combat, use only the single highest value of X):
rtexts.Clone: Models with this Special Rule must reduce certain Advanced Characteristics, but gain increased resilience.
rtexts.Aberrant: Models with this Special Rule must reduce certain Advanced Characteristics, but gain increased combat powers.
rtexts.Linked Cogitator Units: Models with this Special Rule can Control Objectives, and score bonus Victory Points based on the size of the Unit.
rtexts.Malignant: Models with this Special Rule suffer more harm from Perils of the Warp.
rtexts.To Fight and Die Alone: A Model with this Special Rule cannot join Units, but gains bonuses when fighting alone.
rtexts.Endless Horde (X): This Special Rule can replace a Unit that has been wiped out with a new one in Reserves.
rtexts.Équipage de Rapier: The Characteristics of different Models with this Special Rule are used in different situations.
rtexts.Frères Loups de Russ: A Unit containing Models with this Special Rule may never be joined by any Model other than Leman Russ.
rtexts.Assaut Templier: Templar Brethren can close with their opponents more effectively when charging after they Disembark.
rtexts.Spectres: If a Unit which only includes Models with the Raven Guard Trait that has the Troops Battlefield Role is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected:
rtexts.Gorgon Terminator Armour (Legacies): The following Models can have Gorgon Terminator Armour selected for them for +30 Points per Model:
rtexts.Terminator Paladin of the Hekatonystika: If a Centurion in Terminator Armour that has the Dark Angels Trait is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the Paladin of the Hekatonystika Prime Advantage can be selected for it. If this Prime Advantage is selected for a Centurion in Terminator Armour, its powerweapon is exchanged for a Terranic greatsword for Free instead of its bolter.
rtexts.Déplacement Télékinétique: If a Unit which only includes Models with the Thousand Sons Trait and the Troops Battlefield Role is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected:
rtexts.Mise au Pas Brutale: A Model with this Special Rule may target a friendly Unit with a Shooting Attack and the targeted Unit loses the Routed Tactical Status.
rtexts.Trophées du Jugement: Any Model with the Command or Champion Sub-Type and the Night Lords Trait may have Trophies of Judgement selected for it for +10 Points per Model.
rtexts.Rite de la Pensée Pure: A Model with this Special Rule may not make Reactions or Volley Attacks and suffers other limitations.
rtexts.Maléfique: The following Rules apply to all Models with the Malefic Sub-Type:
rtexts.Inarrêtable: The following Rules apply to all Models with the Unstoppable Sub-Type:
rtexts.Acquisitor: All Models with the Acquisitor Trait (excluding Models with the Vehicle Type) gain the Line(1) Special Rule.
rtexts.Expurgator: All Models with the Expurgator Trait (excluding Models with the Vehicle Type) gain the Vanguard(3) Special Rule.
rtexts.Maréchal Élu: This Reaction allows the Controlling Player to select an Ordinator to gain the Command Sub-Type and improved Weapon Skill and Leadership.
rtexts.Bound in Blood: Models subject to this benefit gain positive Modifiers to their Leadership and Cool Characteristics as the Battle progresses.
rtexts.Exact the Price: This Reaction allows the Reacting Unit to improve their Characteristics when Charged by an enemy Unit.
rtexts.Spiteful Strike: This Gambit allows the Controlling Player to make one attack in the Focus Step, but if that attack fails to destroy their opponent’s Model, their Model is destroyed instead.
rtexts.Beholden to None: If slain by the opposing Model, D3 wounds are inflicted on that Model.
rtexts.Desecrators: Models with this Special Rule that pass a Willpower Check gain the Line (X) Special Rule.
rtexts.Primal Terror: Opposing Units must make Leadership Checks when making a Reaction triggered by, or a Charge targeting a Model with this Special Rule.
rtexts.Herald of Unreality: While all Daemons represent the instability of the veil between realms, there are instances of some further weakening of the barrier holding back the entities of the Warp. Their very presence twists the world around them, providing a bridge into reality over which more Daemons can cross.
rtexts.Champion of the Dominion: During the Challenge Sub-Phase, if a Model with this Special Rule is eligible, it must be declared as the Challenger or to accept a Challenge. If more than one Model with this Special Rule is eligible to be the Challenger or to accept a Challenge, the Controlling Player may select which one will be declared as the Challenger or to accept a Challenge.
rtexts.Forward Deployment: A Model with this Special Rule can be deployed anywhere on the Battlefield that is at least 12" from any point within the opposing Player’s Deployment Zone.
rtexts.Orbital Defence: Enemy Drop Pods that deploy within 18" of a Model with this Special Rule suffer automatic Hits.
rtexts.Macro: A Weapon with this Special Rule may only be used to attack an enemy Unit that fulfils one of the following conditions:
rtexts.Battlements: The roof spaces of many Buildings are identified as Battlements. Whilst all Battlements are built on top of a Building, Battlements are not themselves treated as Buildings. Battlements are treated as a zone of Medium Area Terrain that grants a 5+ Cover Save and count as an Access Point for the Building they serve as the roof for.
rtexts.Landing Pad: If a Model with the Flyer Sub-Type that is assigned a Drop Mission ends a Move made as part of that Mission within 3" of a Model with this Special Rule, the Controlling Player may choose to deploy any disembarking Models onto any point on the Model with this Special Rule instead of in Base Contact with the Flyer Model they were Embarked upon.
rtexts.Minimum Range (X): A Model with this Special Rule may only be used to attack an enemy Unit that is at a range equal to or greater than the value of X attached to the specific variant of this Special Rule that it has.
